title: Concept: Repository URL recorded over cleartext
description: package.json declares a `repository.url` over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `repository.url` over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `repository.url` over cleartext.
